CQ:other_goals.name: Other Goals Question
CQ:other_goals.question_template_en: Are there goals other than {G} that should have priority?

CQ:other_means.name: Other Means Question
CQ:other_means.question_template_en: Are there alternative actions to {A} that also achieve {G}?

CQ:side_effect.name: Side Effects Question
CQ:side_effect.question_template_en: Would performing {A} have undesirable side effects?

CQ:possibility.name: Possibility Question
CQ:possibility.question_template_en: Is it actually possible to perform action {A}?

CQ:best_means.name: Best Means Question
CQ:best_means.question_template_en: Is {A} the best way to achieve {G}?

CQ:evidence.name: Evidence Question
CQ:evidence.question_template_en: Is there sufficient evidence for the claimed connection between {A} and {G}?

CQ:likelihood.name: Likelihood Question
CQ:likelihood.question_template_en: How likely is it that the claimed effect will actually occur?

CQ:other_event.name: Other Event Question
CQ:other_event.question_template_en: Is there another event that would more reliably account for {A}?

CQ:expertise.name: Expertise Question
CQ:expertise.question_template_en: How credible is {W} as an expert source in {D}?

CQ:field.name: Field Question
CQ:field.question_template_en: Is the claim {S} within the field {D}?

CQ:trustworthiness.name: Trustworthiness Question
CQ:trustworthiness.question_template_en: Is {W} reliable as a source, honest and unbiased?

CQ:consistency.name: Consistency Question
CQ:consistency.question_template_en: Is {S} consistent with what other credible sources assert?

CQ:backup_evidence.name: Backup Evidence Question
CQ:backup_evidence.question_template_en: Is the assertion of {W} based on evidence?

CQ:position.name: Position to Know Question
CQ:position.question_template_en: Is {W} in a position to know about {D}?

CQ:difference.name: Difference Question
CQ:difference.question_template_en: Are there relevant differences between {C} and the present case?

CQ:truth.name: Truth Question
CQ:truth.question_template_en: Is {A} really true in the case {C}?

CQ:other_case.name: Other Case Question
CQ:other_case.question_template_en: Is there another case, more on point than {C}, in which {A} is false?

CQ:legitimate_value.name: Legitimate Value Question
CQ:legitimate_value.question_template_en: Is {V} really a positive value for {A}?

CQ:value_effect.name: Value Effect Question
CQ:value_effect.question_template_en: Does the value {V} really bear on the goal {G} of {A}?
